summary: Created from the user's Grow screenshots. MaskManager._morph is a Gaussian blur plus an alpha threshold, which averages instead of taking a maximum - large convex shapes grow correctly, thin limbs thin out and concave gaps fill. Filed under the MPI-440 umbrella and sequenced BEFORE MPI-436, which reuses the same primitive.

User confirmed the scope: grow AND edge, outward AND inward - all four read _morph and all four change. Title now names them. Added the consequence: 'blur once, threshold twice' is not retunable, since one averaging pass cannot be both a max and a min filter - the two ADJUST_ thresholds die with the blur.

Implementation started. Approach settled: an exact separable Euclidean distance transform built ONCE in beginAdjust(), thresholded per frame - not the N-stamp Minkowski disc the card floated. Radius becomes free, both ADJUST_ thresholds die with the blur, and the EDT core is pure so the geometry is finally testable in node.
Derived 4 phases from plan.md: pure distance-field module, wire into MaskManager, the test that fails on blur-and-threshold, measure at 1536 and correct docs/masking-adjust.md.

PASSED. 408/408 node tests, eslint clean, and a Chromium probe at 1536 on a thin+concave subject: grow 20 lands the 14px arm edges at exactly 481/534 with the 86px gap open, the 10/10 band spans exactly 591-610, shrink 50 lands the torso edge at exactly 651. User validated Grow +50 and a 35px outward band in the app.

_morph and both ADJUST_ thresholds deleted; the primitive is an exact signed squared Euclidean distance field built once per beginAdjust(). Entry costs 125ms at 1536 and each frame 3.5ms flat in r, against the blur's free entry and 8.7ms/frame. Unblocks MPI-436.
Archived out of board.columns.done to .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/_archived/MPI-441/ (workspace preserved intact). mpi-archive run 2026-08-21.
